d:
New political equations are taking shape in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Azad are set to share a stage in Lucknow on November 12, raising the possibility of a new political alliance. Could their coming together pose a challenge to Akhilesh Yadav and the Samajwadi Party? The results of the 2024 UP by-elections offer some clues.
Production: Nitish Kumar
Video Editor: Maneesh Negi
